doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Expansion of Share Acquisition Framework
doc_title_jp: 自己株式の取得枠拡大に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 2027年3月期連結業績予想の上方修正

summary_en: The company expanded its share buyback authorization from 18 million shares (¥3.4 billion) to 21 million shares (¥4.0 billion), representing 2.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The expansion was triggered by upward revision of fiscal 2027 earnings guidance, consistent with the shareholder return policy targeting 100% total payout ratio.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の連結業績予想上方修正に伴い、自己株式の取得上限を30万株増加させ、210万株（4億円）に拡大した。発行済株式総数（自己株式を除く）の2.6％に相当し、ROE8％達成まで配当性向70％を基準に総還元性向100％を目指す方針のもと実施される。
tag_jp: 自己株式取得枠の拡大

doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision (Increase) of Surplus Dividend (Interim Dividend) and Full-Year Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
doc_title_jp: 剰余金の配当（中間配当）および期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 連結業績予想の上方修正を受け、配当性向70%を目安とする株主還元方針に基づき増配

summary_en: Japan Securities Finance raised interim dividend to 56 yen per share (vs. 47 yen forecast) for fiscal year ending March 2027, and revised full-year dividend forecast to 112 yen per share (vs. 94 yen) on upward revision of earnings guidance. The increases reflect commitment to 70% dividend payout ratio target under total shareholder return policy.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の中間配当を56円に決定し、期末配当予想を56円に修正、年間配当を112円に増配。連結業績予想の上方修正に伴うもので、配当性向70%を目安とした株主還元方針に基づいている。

doc_title_en: Update on Measures for Realizing Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Share Price, and Status of Shareholder Dialogue – as of May 2026

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現に向けた対応として、東京証券取引所の要請事項についての更新

summary_en: Cost of capital remeasured at 6% early-2020s band using multi-method long-term time-series analysis. Management target: consolidated operating profit >¥10B + ROE >5% maintained and further improved. FY2025 results: operating profit ¥14.9B, ROE 7.8%, dividend per share ¥86 (raised), share buyback ¥3.4B (¥600M increase), total shareholder return ratio 98.5%. PBR >1.0x and TSR materially above TOPIX in stable conditions through Apr 2025.
summary_jp: 資本コストを早期2020年代6%台前半と改定測定。経営目標：連結経常利益100億円超・ROE5%超維持・さらなる向上。FY2025実績：経常利益149億円、ROE7.8%、配当86円増配、自己株式34億円取得、総還元性向98.5%。PBR1倍超・TSRはTOPIX大幅上回る水準で推移。
tag_en: Cost of Capital Initial Target – ROE >5% (achieved 7.8% FY2025), operating profit ¥14.9B, maintenance target with progressive trajectory through FY2026+
tag_jp: 資本コスト初期目標／ROE 5%超（FY2025実績7.8%）、営業利益149億円、FY2026以降段階的向上方針

doc_title_en: Notice of Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation under Company Law Article 165, Paragraph 2)

key_facts.reason_jp: ROE8%達成までの間、配当および自己株式取得の機動的な実施により総還元性向100%を目指す

summary_en: 1.8M shares (2.2% of S/O), ¥3.4B upper limit, May 15, 2026–Mar 31, 2027 execution window, open-market method. Rationale: support ROE 8% target via total payout ratio of 100% (dividends + buybacks) until goal achieved.
summary_jp: 180万株（2.2%）、34億円上限、2026年5月15日～2027年3月31日、公開市場方式。ROE8%達成まで配当と自己株式取得で総還元性向100%を目指す。
tag_en: Buyback - 1.8M shares (2.2% S/O) - ¥3.4B - Open market, May 2026–Mar 2027
tag_jp: 自己株式取得：180万株（2.2%）／34億円／公開市場、2026年5月～2027年3月
